messages:
alex: Quick coordination — proposing the Go/No-Go sync for release v2.3 on Wed Oct 12 at 15:00 PT. Need a short roster of stakeholders (prod, infra, QA, SRE, PM) and a 20-min agenda. Can folks confirm availability or suggest an alternative slot?

maria: 15:00 PT works for me. I can cover release QA signoff and test run checklist.

kevin: I might be tight at 15:00. +1 for 14:30 PT if that helps folks. Otherwise I can join 15:00 for the final 10.

jia: I can do either. Will prep the deploy rollback plan and quick flakiness notes.

alex: Thanks. If 14:30 makes attendance better we can try that. Quick poll: 14:30 PT or 15:00 PT? Reply with :one: for 14:30, :two: for 15:00.

luis: :two: — prefer 15:00 so QA has more time after smoke.

kevin: :one: then — I can join earlier and help with canary checks.

alex: OK mixed. I'll aim for 15:00 PT but add a 14:30 dry-run invite for owners who want to pre-run canaries.

alex: Agenda draft (20m total):
```
1) Roll status & blocker quickcheck (5m) — owners callouts
2) Canary/smoke readiness and gating (7m) — infra/SRE + canary owners
3) Rollback/mitigation plan confirm (4m) — ops
4) Final go/no-go and action item assign (4m)
```
Please comment if we should add a platform/observability gating metric.

maria: Suggest adding one line under canary: "Required SLO pass rate >= 98% on early traffic" so it's concrete.

jia: Adding: "If latency p95 increases >20% vs baseline, trigger hold" — ok?

alex: Nice. I'll fold both in. Also proposing a light roster template for the meeting note so we can capture attendees quickly:
```
- Release owner: alex
- QA lead: maria
- Infra/SRE: kevin
- PM: luis
- Canary owners: jia, kevin
- Observability: (open)
```

kevin: I can own observability during the call; will run the quick traces and alert status.

luis: I'll be there for the final decision and to confirm comms cadence.

alex: Two logistical asks: 1) owners please paste any short preflight checklists into this thread before EOD Mon Oct 10, 2) if you need a private pre-call with infra, ping me to set 14:30 dry-run.

prod-bot: Created calendar draft for "v2.3 Go/No-Go — 2026-10-12" at 15:00 PT. Invite will be updated if time changes.

maria: Preflight checklist (summary): smoke tests, canary config uploaded, migrations dry-run complete, metrics alert thresholds set. Will paste details tomorrow.

alex: Awesome — that should be enough to write the invite and agenda. I'll send the official calendar slot at 15:00 PT and include the dry-run optional at 14:30 for owners. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

kevin: One more: can we add a short note in the invite about required zoom + runbook link? I can attach runbook once calendar is live.

alex: Yep — will include zoom and runbook link placeholder.

luis: If anyone can't attend, please delegate a backup and add to the roster.

alex: Will follow up with the invite and final roster update tomorrow morning.

maria: Thanks — I'll post the detailed QA checklist by EOD.

(ends)
